verdict.rationale: n8n documents Git-based source control with push/pull for workflows (env promotion) and error-handling workflows, and community feedback confirms execution history lets users see what happened on failures, giving debugging/review capability. However, this Git version control feature is pricing-page listed (implying it's a paid/Enterprise tier feature) and there's no dedicated 'rollback to previous version' UI documented, nor independent confirmation of rollback workflows. Missing for 10: clear rollback/restore mechanism in UI, confirmation source control is available in Community edition, independent hands-on account of versioning/rollback in practice.
